en: With a strange whirring, a Tetramystica glides across the floor.{w}{p}A Tetramystica specialized for guard duty -- a "Guard Mystica," you might call it.{w}{p}Here and there the students have scrawled on it: "Idiot," "Moron," even doodled nose hairs.{w}Even so, its function of guarding the Academy is still fully intact.{w}{p}So it is only natural that, on spotting you outsiders who don't belong to the Academy, it moves to eliminate you.{w}
note: Tetramystica = monster name (MONRAW), romanized; 'Guard Mystica' keeps the clipped coinage. Gakufu = 'the Academy' (Santorea Academy dungeon, DGN_NAME 28-30). Nose hairs = doodled on it like the insults.

en: You have run into a foe you never expected.{w}A vast form, its whole body blazing with light.{w}{p}Without a sound, the very air shudders and trembles.{w}With the word "alien" lodged in your hearts, you stand exposed to its savage power.{w}
note: 'ishitsu' -> "alien" (of a wholly different nature).

en: Suddenly, a gigantic beast appears before you.{w}Half tiger and half horse, it flails its arms and thrashes its whole body wildly.{w}{p}And now its fury turns on you as well.{w}
note: Editorial: progressive 'is wildly flailing ... its whole body' read awkwardly in present-tense narration.

en:
Darkness within darkness.{w}Welling up from the abode of the Nether King, it fills the air around it with an incomprehensible tongue.{w}{p}What it is saying: unknown.{w}What it is even trying to do: unknown.{w}{p}But one thing is clear:
it means to destroy you.{w}
note: 'kuraki ou' -> 'the Nether King' (title, not in glossary). Kept the terse 'unknown' fragments as deliberate style.

en:
A giant leaps out in front of you.{w}It seems to be distracted by something else.{w}{p}It doesn't appear able to tell whether you are enemies or mere visitors.{w}{p}No -- for just a moment it seemed to give it some thought, but
'Eh, I'll just punch them for now and...'{w}seems to be the conclusion it reached.{w}
note: Inner thought in single quotes (source uses the double-corner brackets); trailing-off kept. Giant -> 'it' (gender unknown).

en: You succeeded in driving off the fearsome enemy.
note: Source string is damaged: the first kana of 'osoroshii' (fearsome) is missing and a stray half-width long-vowel mark stands in its place. Translated the evident full meaning. Source has no {w}; none added.

en: The Floor Master spotted you{w}
note: op031 system/telop line; short, no period like the source.

en: You shook off the Floor Master{w}
note: op031 system/telop line.

You obtained an item, but couldn't carry it.{w}

note: Prompt; number of enemies unknown, plural chosen (group encounter).

No

# Divine Shadow check start

Debug; full-width indent -> 5 spaces so the colon aligns under VICTORY_COUNT.

en: No Divine Shadow
note: Debug.

en:
You sense a great presence and stop in your tracks.{w}{p}In an instant the presence blankets the world, bearing down on you with overwhelming force.{w}{p}This is the shadow of one who lies "outside" the world.{w}A being unlike you.{w}{p}Beware!
You must never encounter it!{w}{p}This is a warning.{w}
Hide, lest your souls be blown away.
note: Single forced choice (data). Full sense: 'Hide yourselves before your souls are blown away.' (49); shortened to 35 -- over the ~30 menu guide; flag for fit check.

en: You held your breath and waited for the calamity to pass.{w}{p}"It" vanished in an instant, just as it had appeared.{w}

You feel a great temptation and falter.{w}{p}In an instant the temptation blankets your reason, bearing down on you with overwhelming allure.{w}{p}This is the costume change of one who lies "outside" common sense.{w}A being unlike you.{w}{p}Beware!
You must never awaken to it!{w}{p}This is a warning.{w}
note: Parody of row 50: 'kage' (shadow) -> 'kigae' (change of clothes). Sound pun not reproducible; kept the parallel structure. 'mezamete wa naranai' = must never be awakened (to a kink) -> 'awaken to it'.

en: Obey, lest your reason be blown away.
note: Parody of row 51. Full sense: 'Do as you're told before your reason is blown away.' 37 chars; flag for fit check.

en:
The giant shadow that appeared before you looked somehow familiar.{w}{p}It walked away without a word.{w}{p}Was it just your imagination?
Its lips seemed to curl into a faint smile.{w}
Searching the area, you found something.{w}
Take it?
if it fits
note: op093 branch label, damaged fragment ('...ru baai' = 'case where (it) ...'). Probably never shown; meaning inferred from rows 60/62.

en:
[Key Item]
Obtained {0C:0001:0001}.{w}
if it doesn't
note: op093 branch label fragment ('...nai baai'). Probably never shown.

en: You left {0C:0001:0001} behind.{w}
note: 'houki shita' = gave up / abandoned the item.

en: Lightstair Ruins
note: Key item / insert name (ITEM_PRIZ 4:3). 'hikari no kaiseki' = remains of the Stair of Light (castle line 91152 glosses it that way). 16 chars. NEW TERM.

en: Hemaid Red Stone
note: ITEM_PRIZ 5:3. 'Hemaid' = the red Phantom Stone (pun on hematite); siblings Plakio (green), Menon (blue). 18 chars.

en: The Stairway of Light stretches up toward the Palace of the Sun.{w}But you can't touch it!{w}{p}It seems that by entering the Palace of the Sun some other way, you lost the right to climb the Stairway of Light.{w}
note: 'hikari no kaidan' -> 'Stair of Light' (new term).

en: The Stairway of Light stretches up toward the Palace of the Sun.{w}But you can't touch it.{w}
The Stairway of Light stretches up toward the Palace of the Sun.{w}
Go to the Palace of the Sun?
Balgert

note: Balgert (king of Algrantz per slice_02; rough speech) -> blunt, casual English. 'genseki' -> 'Phantom Stone' (new term).

en: "What, you haven't done it yet!{w}Come on, let's hurry up and bring out that stairway!"{w}
note: Editorial: 'get that stair out' was unidiomatic.

en: "Looks like you're all set!{w}Look, Natori and Mayleen came out for us too!"{w}
note: 'kite kureta' = came (for our sake) -> 'came out for us'.

en: Natori
"You got all three Phantom Stones! That's amazing!"{w}
note: 'sangenseki' -> 'all three Phantom Stones'.

en: Mayleen
"My, you people are quite capable.{w}You rise ever higher in my esteem!"{w}
note: Mayleen: refined 'desu wa' speech -> formal, slightly haughty English. 'masumasu minaoshita' = thinks even better of them than before. Natori's next line reacts to this unusual praise.

en: "M-Mayleen...?"{w}
note: Natori taken aback by Mayleen's praise.

en: "What is it?"{w}
"N-no, nothing..."{w}
"...Save the celebrating for when the Stairway of Light appears."{w}
"Will it really show up, even in conditions like these?"{w}
"I don't believe we need concern ourselves with the weather or the time of day."{w}
note: Editorial: dropped added emphasis 'in the least' (accuracy item 4); wording follows 'need not worry about' in Mayleen's formal register.

en: "Why not?"{w}
"They say Rafa climbed these very stairs to reach the Palace of the Sun, don't they?"{w}
note: Honorific -sama on Rafa dropped (Rafa gender unknown, so no Lord/Lady); Mayleen's respectful tone carried by phrasing.

en: "Yeah."{w}
"There was no sun back then, so it can't have been sunny or daytime either.{w}The conditions are the same, you see."{w}
"Oh, I get it!"{w}
As if in answer to the two of them, light flooded the surroundings!{w}

"Right, from here on out we're in the realm of myth.{w}Anything could happen.
Don't you lot go losing your nerve on me!!"{w}
Soldier
"Lord Balgert, the three Phantom Stones have begun to glow!"{w}
note: Balgert-sama -> "Lord Balgert" (kept literal for consistency; "Your Majesty" also possible since Balgert is king, see row 105). Mitsu-genseki -> "the three Phantom Stones".

en:
"Yeaaaaahhh!!"{w}{p}"You lot...
thanks for letting me do my duty as king."{w}{p}"These folks here are the finest Algrantz has to offer."{w}{p}"We'll bring the sun back, no question, so just sit tight and wait for us!"{w}
note: Pages 2-4: Balgert addresses "omee-ra" (thanks, probably to the party) and then the soldiers (introducing the party as Algrantz's elite, telling them to wait). "You lot" kept so it works for either listener.

en: "All right, you lot!{w}We're storming the Palace of the Sun!!"{w}
With a war cry, Balgert charged toward the stairs.{w}But...{w}
"Gwah!?"{w}
Balgert's foot passed right through the Stairway of Light.{w}
"What the hell...?"{w}
note: dou iu koto da -- rough-voiced bewilderment; "hell" matches Balgert's register.

en: Mayleen reached out to touch the stairs as well, only for her fingertips to slip right through too.{w}
note: Source "sono yubisaki" (those fingertips); no pronoun used since Mayleen's gender is not in the glossary. | Editorial: glossary now lists Mayleen as female; pronoun replaces 'those fingertips'.

en: "Everyone, over here, please.{w}...Now, give me a paw."{w}
note: O-te = the "shake/paw" command given to a dog; Mayleen is jokingly ordering the party to put a hand on the stairs.

en: At Mayleen's urging, you tried touching the stairs.{w}...It seems that you, at least, can touch them.{w}
"I see. It seems the stairs choose who may use them."{w}
"No way... You've gotta be kidding me!?"{w}
Balgert stood before the stairs once more and tried to set a foot on them.{w}
But his foot could not find purchase on the step.{w}
note: Editorial: Balgert is named in row 103 directly before; pronoun (glossary: male) avoids the repetition.

en: "I'm the king of Algrantz, damn it!{w}All I'm trying to do is take back the Palace of the Sun!{w}And you're telling me I'm STILL not worthy!?"{w}
note: O = king (source word). "damn it" carries the emphatic zo; caps on STILL for soredemo -- drop if caps are unwanted.

en: "Lord Balgert, please calm down!"{w}{p}"Maybe only the ones who searched out the Phantom Stones and made the stairs appear can climb them!"{w}
"True enough. It isn't the sort of place one storms with a whole army."{w}
"So what, you're telling me to dump the fate of the whole land on these guys' shoulders!?"{w}
note: koitsu-ra = the party.

en: "A heavy job like that is exactly the kind a king's supposed to steel himself and take on!!{w}Damn it...!!"{w}
note: "himself" refers to a king in general (the source noun "o"), not a gender call on a specific person. | Editorial: same oath spelled 'damn it' in row 105.

en: Balgert clenched his fist in bitter frustration.{w}Then, as if he had come to a decision, he turned to face you.{w}
note: Name repeated instead of "he/his": glossary gender for Balgert is unknown. | Editorial: glossary now lists Balgert as male; pronouns replace the repeated name.

en: "Truth is...{w}I meant to lead the army up there myself, but... well, you can see how that went."{w}{p}"It's hard, putting something this big on the shoulders of plain adventurers, but...{w}would you take back the Palace of the Sun in my place?"{w}{p}"I, Balgert, ask this of you as the favor of a lifetime.{w}Please, I'm counting on you!"{w}
note: Issho no tanomi = "favor of a lifetime"; "kono Balgert" self-naming kept as "I, Balgert".

en: As if beckoning you, the Stairway of Light shone brighter still.{w}
You tried touching the stairs as well.{w}...But you could not touch them.{w}
note: Alternate branch: the party already entered the Palace another way (cf. rows 65 and 114-116).

en: "Could it be... that you have already been inside the Palace of the Sun?"{w}
note: Source is missing its closing quote bracket (likely a source typo); closing quote added in English.

en: "Now that you mention it, I did hear a rumor like that..."{w}

"Most likely, there is only one road to the Palace of the Sun."{w}{p}"Once, this Stairway of Light was the only way to the Palace."{w}{p}"But now that surface technology can reach it as well, to keep interference from the surface to a bare minimum,{w}{p}some power guarding the Palace of the Sun must be blocking the Stairway of Light."{w}{p}"In other words, only they can enter the Palace of the Sun... That's what it comes to, I suppose."{w}
note: Page 1: "michi wa hitotsu" = only one road (implied: a party that entered another way loses the stairs; not spelled out, so not added). Page 3->4 is one sentence split across a page break, so page 4 has no opening quote, as in the source. "they" (karera) = the party, said to Natori.

en: "Lord Balgert, please calm down!"{w}
Girl's Voice
"The presence of darkness grows thicker still..."{w}{p}"Mayer, can you truly free and save Rafa?"{w}
note: New name Mayer (meiyaa). Rafa repeated instead of a pronoun (gender unknown). Speaker is the Girl's Voice; row 126 calls her "that Moonlight Spirit". | Editorial: 'free Rafa and save Rafa' read stiffly; merged verbs, still no pronoun (Rafa gender unknown).

en: Man's Voice
"Of course. Once all is done, I will take you all to whatever land you desire, as promised."{w}
note: omae-tachi = plural "you"; who is included is not stated.

en:
"......"{w}{p}"Rafa, wait for me...
I won't let you suffer any longer."{w}
Woman's Voice

"My, how desperate.
It's enough to make me cry... Ahahaha!"{w}
note: nakaseru wa ne -- sarcastic "how touching".

en: Strange Voice
note: fushigi na koe; "Mysterious Voice" is exactly 16 chars, so the shorter form.

en: "That Moonlight Spirit seems to have room in her head for nothing but her own goals."{w}
note: New term gekkousei -> "Moonlight Spirit". "her": the spirit referred to is the speaker labelled Girl's Voice (shoujo).

en:
"All the better for us...
Let her dance to our tune while she can."{w}
note: seizei odotte morau -- "let her dance" (same girl as row 126).

en: Rafa
Yorfa
"Well, I never thought it would come to this!"{w}{p}"It's all because of that swindler, that Zaalhaut or whatever...{w}That wretch...!!"{w}
note: petenshi = swindler/con artist.

en: "She did a great deal for us."{w}
note: Source says kanojo ("she"). Context (reply to row 131) makes the referent Zaalhaut, whose glossary gender is unknown and who speaks with old-man "washi" elsewhere -- kept "She" because the source says it; flag for glossary.

en: "But your body, Rafa, it keeps getting more and more...!"{w}
note: Trails off in source; kept unfinished.

en: "You understand, don't you?"{w}
"You're being deceived."{w}
"What?"{w}
"You're so kind, Rafa, that everyone takes advantage and deceives you."{w}{p}"They use you however they please...{w}Poor, poor Rafa."{w}
note: Yorfa uses Rafa's name in place of "you" throughout; rendered as you + vocative.

en: "Yorfa?"{w}
"It's all right. I'll save you, okay?{w}I'll set you free from all that pain, okay?"{w}
"What are you planning, Yorfa!?"{w}
"Shaharon and the others are going to separate you from the True Crystal, Rafa."{w}{p}"Until then, I won't let anyone into this Chamber of the True Sun."{w}
note: New name Shaharon; new terms shinsuishou -> "True Crystal", shinjitsu no ma -> "Chamber of the True Sun".

en: "Yorfa! That's enough!{w}I'm doing this of my own free will!"{w}
"It's all right, Rafa.{w}I'll protect you.{w}I'll save you, I swear."{w}
"...So now... even my words can't reach you...{w}Yorfa..."{w}
"Rafa... I love you so much..."{w}
"D-don't come any closer..."{w}
"My precious Rafa...{w}My very own Rafa..."{w}
"Don't touch me!{w}You're out of your mind right now!"{w}
note: ima no omae wa kurutteru -- "the you of right now is mad".

en: "Why?{w}Why would you say something like that?"{w}
"Yorfa! Please, go back to who you used to be!"{w}{p}"We watched over the land together in Nertowa, didn't we!"{w}{p}"Be the way you were back then! I'm begging you!!"{w}
note: New name Nertowa (place, nerutowa).

en:
"It's all right, we can go back."{w}{p}"Once I set you free, you and I will be just like before.
Like old times... together forever..."{w}{p}"Nothing else matters..."{w}
"Listen, Rafa..."{w}{p}"I won't let you suffer any longer."{w}{p}"If it means losing you..."{w}
note: Sentence continues in row 156 (anata wo ushinau kurai nara / daichi nado yami ni...); cut at the same point.

en: "...then let the land be swallowed by darkness."{w}
note: Continuation of row 155; dupes 3 -- in every place it follows 155.

en: "Why...{w}Why do you keep getting in my way?"{w}
note: Addressed to the party (anata-tachi).

en: In the Chamber of the True Sun, at the very heart of the Palace of the Sun, was the Moonlight Spirit, Yorfa.{w}
"Beyond here... is where Rafa is, you know.{w}Yes, my very own Rafa.{w}Mine, and mine alone..."{w}
note: Source has no stops after the first two segments; punctuation added.

en: Yorfa went on, wearing a look of rapture.{w}
note: Narration in past tense, matching the pilot's narration style.

en: "Would you all please step back?{w}I'm begging you, don't get in my way."{w}{p}"I'll ask you once more.{w}Would you please step back, adventurers?"{w}
note: Also reused in castle-talk scripts (91152, 91251); kept generic. Yorfa asks the party to step back; polite-request form kept.

en: "...I see. Then it can't be helped."{w}
Little by little, Yorfa began to change.{w}
"......{w}Rafaaa...{w}RAFAAAAAAAAAAAA!"{w}
note: Stretched scream of Rafa (glossary spelling) kept as an elongated 'Rafaaa' / 'RAFAAA...'.

en: "Why?{w}Why won't you just leave me be?"{w}
note: Source has no object for 'leave alone' (sotto shite oite). Rendered 'leave me be'; could also be read as 'leave us (Yorfa and Rafa) alone'.

en: Tears poured endlessly from Yorfa's eyes.{w}
"I just... I just...{w}I just want to save Rafa...{w}That's all, and yet..."{w}
note: Row 169 is the same line without the opening fragment; both rendered identically from 'I just want to save Rafa...' on.

en: "I just want to save Rafa...{w}That's all, and yet..."{w}
"Thank you."{w}
note: Reused in 4 places (incl. 91431 town script); plain 'Thank you.' works everywhere.

en: From here, the Stairway of Light must once have stretched all the way up to the Palace of the Sun.{w}{p}But now the place lay desolate, a mere shadow of what it had been, with nothing divine left about it.{w}There was no sign that the Stairway of Light would appear, either.{w}{p}Was something missing?{w}
note: 'Stairway of light' (hikari no kaidan) left descriptive/lowercase; it recurs in slices 01, 02, 06, 08 -- unify if the project decides it is a proper name.

en: As you puzzled over it, the rocks around you began to roll in an unnatural way.{w}Grinding and clattering, they gathered into a human shape.{w}

A colossus made of rock appeared before you.{w}Was it the guardian of this place?{w}{p}All around, birds and insects began to gather, as though driven by some will of their own.{w}{p}They must be the protectors of the sacred ruins.{w}You would have to face this trial.{w}
note: Kyozou = 'colossus'. Narration past tense.

en: Under your attacks, the colossus began to crumble.{w}The small creatures that had gathered around it went on their way, as though freed from a spell.{w}

note: Control codes only; kept verbatim.

en: "Hey, you there..."{w}
note: Speaker box is 'Woman's Voice' (row 123, slice_02). Same laugh as Necrophilis, so this is her.

en: A voice came from out of nowhere.{w}

"So this is our first time meeting face to face, huh...
Not that I'll bother telling you my name.{w}I doubt you'll be needing it."{w}
note: 'You won't need it' implies they will not live to use it; kept that undertone.

en: In an instant, a red-haired woman appeared before you.{w}
Red-Haired Woman
note: Name box, 16 chars.

en:
"Hey...
There's no point in you holding on to that thing, is there?"{w}
Talking in a flat, detached voice, she walked toward you.{w}

"It doesn't look like it's worth a thing...
but you'd be in trouble without it, right?{w}Well, whatever. In that case, why not give it to me?"{w}
note: 'Sore' = the worthless-looking object the party carries (unnamed here).

en: Hand it over?
"Come on. Hand it over already!"{w}
note: Placed between the choice and the refusal branch; read as her impatient demand (likely the no/hesitation path). Wording works either way.

en:
This woman looked human, yet she was not.
No trace of life could be felt from her.{w}
"Hmm... So you're dead set on not handing it over.{w}Then I guess there's only one way to do this!"{w}

"Tch...{w}You're better than I thought."{w}{p}"Well, whatever you lot do,
the outcome won't change."{w}
note: She switches from kimitachi to the rougher antatachi -> 'you lot'.

en:
"Ahahaha!
Go on, keep struggling for all you're worth!"{w}
Necrophilis

"I am Necrophilis! The next time we meet,
I will be the one to destroy you! Remember that!"{w}
note: Her speech turns harsh/commanding (omae-tachi, oboete oke); rendered more forcefully than her earlier casual tone.

en:
Leaving only her laughter behind,
the woman vanished into the darkness.{w}
"You there... Wait."{w}
From where the voice had come, a spirit with a face like the Grim Reaper's appeared before you.{w}
note: Shinigami -> 'the Grim Reaper'.

en: Spirit

note: Villain register, no contractions. 'Let you die without suffering' -- even compliance means death; kept.

en: Leave it behind?
"A wise choice.{w}And while I am at it, I may as well finish my other business."{w}
note: Source uses the kenmei homophone meaning 'diligent', almost certainly a typo for the kenmei meaning 'wise'; translated as 'A wise choice'. 'Other business' = killing them anyway.

en: The spirit took a step forward.{w}

"I see...
So you would choose an agonizing death..."{w}{p}"If that is what you wish, I shall grant it."{w}

"...Heh heh.{w}Fighting back here has merely
put off your own deaths..."{w}
note: Post-battle line (the party resisted).

en: Shaharon
note: New name: Shaharon (not in glossary; also appears in slices 02 and 14).

en: The spirit vanished, as if melting into the darkness.{w}

"You there...
What do you intend to do with that thing in your hands?"{w}
note: Speaker box is 'Man's Voice' (slice_02 row 127 uses the same label).

en: A voice suddenly rang out from behind you.{w}From where it had come, a demon appeared, wreathed in a hideous aura unlike anything you had ever seen.{w}
note: No pronoun used for the demon; 'Man's Voice' label exists but glossary gives no gender, so kept to 'the demon'.

en: Demon

"Cast away that useless thing,
turn your backs on what you fear, and flee."{w}{p}"Or... will you struggle, knowing it is futile?{w}If you give up gracefully, I might yet be persuaded to let you go."{w}
note: Proof: "turn your backs on fear" reads as defying fear; source is turn your back on (the thing you fear) and flee.

en: Throw it away?
"Very good.{w}Tell me, do you understand the worth of the Palace of the Sun?"{w}{p}"...Hm, it hardly matters whether you do.{w}You will die here regardless."{w}
note: Kisamara (contemptuous you) -- contempt carried by tone rather than an insult word.

en: With a fearless smile, the demon took a step toward you.{w}
note: Futeki na emi = 'fearless smile'; repeated in row 216.

en: "Oho... So you had this much power hidden away.{w}...This should keep me entertained for a long while."{w}
Dark Mayer
note: New name: Dark Mayer (romanized from Daaku Meiyaa; not in glossary).

en:
"I am Dark Mayer.
Do try to stay alive from here on.{w}I look forward to our next meeting..."{w}

Still wearing that fearless smile, the demon
vanished soundlessly into the darkness.{w}
Rotating Floor{w}
note: op096 label for the TURN_FLOOR script. 'Rotating Floor' chosen over the Wizardry jargon 'Spinner' for clarity; swap if the UI glossary settles on another term.
Unknown-speaker box; question marks kept.

en: "...The hell are you?"{w}
"Tch...{w}What the hell is with you people..."{w}
Brassel
"Don't tell me you wanna join the Brassel Gang?{w}Hah, well, looks like you can handle yourselves."{w}
note: New term: Brassel Gang (Brassel tozokudan, lit. 'Brassel band of thieves'). Brassel's gender not in glossary; no pronouns used for Brassel anywhere in the slice.

en: "...Huh? No?{w}Then why the hell did you come here?"{w}
Underling
note: Kobun -> 'Underling' (gender-neutral).

en:
"Boss, I knew it, they heard about us from that brat...
That little snitch went and blabbed..."{w}
note: The 'brat' is not gendered here; avoided pronouns.

en: "Gyah!"{w}
note: No speaker box: the underling yelping when Brassel hits them.

en: "Shut your trap! Keep quiet!{w}And you lot, get lost already!{w}Show your faces again and this time I'll kill you for real!!"{w}
note: Kondo koso -> 'for real'.

en:
"You came back again!?{w}I'm heading out!!
Hey, kill these guys while I'm gone!!"{w}
note: Koroshite oke -> 'kill these guys while I'm gone' (te-oku = have it done by the time).

en:
"Ow, ow, ow...{w}No way we can win without the boss...
What the heck do you guys keep coming here for..."{w}{p}"It's all that brat's fault anyway...{w}We've never let anybody walk out of here alive before,
and that brat's blabbing about us, I just know it."{w}{p}"...You guys really don't know anything?{w}A while back, near Roscadil,
we jumped this little brat of a girl, see."{w}{p}"...And the boss, who knows what for,
went and let her go."{w}{p}"A little brat in fancy duds like that,{w}we coulda snatched her for a ransom,
or sold her off..."{w}{p}"Crap! The boss is coming back!{w}Please! Just say you got away!{w}Okay? Or the boss is gonna kill us!!"{w}
note: Mesugaki (crude, 'female brat') -> 'little brat of a girl'; she/her is used for this girl only, since mesugaki fixes the gender. 'Oobebe' (baby-talk for nice clothes) -> 'fancy duds'. Avoided he/him for the boss.

en: "Hey! Isn't anybody here!?{w}...Oh, it's you lot."{w}

"...You lot didn't hear anything
from a blond brat, did you?{w}...Then that's fine."{w}
note: Blond brat = presumably the same girl, but not confirmed in-line; no pronoun.

en: "Shut up! It's nothing!"{w}

"..................................
...So even a kid with just one parent gets to wear stuff that nice......"{w}
note: Kept the \n to separate the long silence from the muttered line. Avoided gendering the kid.

en: "...You lot said something about wanting to join up, right?{w}What? You think I'd hear something like that wrong?{w}This job's just you and me. You're coming along."{w}

"The job's at the Blue Cave.{w}Word is, deep inside there's a bunch of mimics
that eat adventurers and hoard treasure."{w}
note: New place name: Blue Cave (ao no doukutsu; also slice 11 rows 862-863).

en: "We hit 'em.{w}Relax, they're just monsters.{w}That's your specialty, right?"{w}
There's no one here.{w}
note: Generic status line reused 6 times; present tense.

en: "All right, this is it! The Soleil Stone!{w}Hey, you lot can have the rest."{w}
note: New item name: Soleil Stone (soreiyu sutoon).

en: Received 5000 GP.{w}

"...By the way, that brat's... No, I'll find the kid myself.{w}...It's a matter of settling up. This is payment for the trouble.{w}Only one parent, and still nothing like me..."{w}{p}"But don't think I'm going straight now.{w}I'm a thief till the day I die. That's who I am.{w}So I'll settle up with loot from a job, too."{w}{p}"And next time we meet, I'll kill you lot too.{w}Don't come to the hideout again."{w}
note: Brassel keeps the Soleil Stone (row 238) as amends for the blond kid from Roscadil (rows 229-233). "the brat"/"the kid" kept gender-neutral. "kataoya da tte no ni, ore to wa oochigai" read with row 233: the kid also has one parent, yet turned out nothing like Brassel ("same as me" is an inference from that contrast -- flag). | Accuracy: 'same as me' removed -- source only says 'kataoya da tte no ni, ore to wa oochigai'; whether Brassel also had one parent is not stated, so the contrast is kept without asserting it.

en: Certain NPCs join your adventure in the summoned-monster slot.{w}{p}If a similar NPC is already with you, another one cannot be added.{w}{p}Either finish the event of the NPC currently with you, or disband your party once at the tavern.{w}
note: System help text.

en: "Oh, it's you guys again!"{w}
"How's it going?"
note: Menu choice.

en: Talk
note: Menu choice.

en: "Electra, come on, let's get going!"{w}
"Wait, I haven't introduced everyone yet.{w}This is Mig.{w}A unicorn, as you can see."{w}{p}"Mig and I have been together since birth,{w}and Mig travels with me like this.{w}And..........."{w}
note: Mig's gender not in glossary: repeated the name instead of a pronoun. "umareta toki kara" is unclear whose birth -- "since birth" keeps it open. Trailing "And..." is cut off by Yamuru.

en: "Yamuru. I'm a bounty hunter.{w}I hear the Proclamation pays a pretty good sum,{w}so they've let me join this party."{w}
note: Source has the variant spelling of the Proclamation term; used glossary "the Proclamation". | Editorial: 'let in on' means sharing a secret; reworded to 'let me join'.

en: "I'm Maniron~! Nice ta meetcha~!"{w}
note: Childish sing-song voice.

en: "My name is Korbitz.{w}We may end up relying on each other from here on,{w}so let's look out for one another, eh?"{w}
Mokero
note: Name box.

en: "The name's Mokero, it is!{w}The Miss has done a whole heap for me,{w}and I'll be followin' the Miss for the rest o' my days!"{w}
note: "Ojou" rendered "the Miss" (Mokero's fixed address for Electra). The source word itself is feminine; this is a translation of the title, not an inferred gender, but flagged since Electra is "unknown" in the glossary. Mokero's humble-roughneck "asshi ... yasu" speech -> dropped g's and "it is!/I will!" tags.

en:
"Mokero, I keep telling you,
you don't have to be so formal..."{w}
"Miss! Don't go sayin' such cold things!{w}The debt I owe you, Miss, is............"{w}
note: Trails off; cut short by Korbitz.

en: "Electra's a kind child, you see,{w}and took us in, just like this.{w}So please, all of you, be good to Electra."{w}
note: Repeated the name instead of a pronoun. | Editorial: added 'and' to fix the dangling clause.

en: "Ugh, honestly! You're all exaggerating!{w}If someone's in trouble, I help them.{w}
note: Unclosed quote as in source; row 256 re-shows this text inside {0E}..{0F} and finishes it.
{0E}..{0F} part mirrors row 255 word for word.

en: "Me too, y'know~ Electra once~"{w}
note: Maniron starts to say Electra helped them too and is cut off by Electra (row 258). Kept as a fragment.

en: "Okay, okay, I get it!{w}Anyway, that's how it is, so be nice to all of us, okay?"{w}

"By the way... yours looks
like a pretty decent party."{w}
note: Yamuru to the player party.

en:
"We might end up competing with each other in all kinds of ways.{w}What do you say? How about you lot
and us have a little test of skill?"{w}
"Hey, Yamuru!"{w}
"These are the people who'll be our rivals from here on.{w}We need to see what they can do now, don't we?"{w}
"Well, that's..."{w}
"Besides, you need the bounty money, right?{w}Or was this something you started half-heartedly?"{w}
note: Yamuru to Electra.

en:
"Electra, what'll we do?
If you're going to fight, I'll help, okay?"{w}
"............Okay, I've made up my mind!"{w}{p}"You guys, let's have a match!{w}All right, everyone, let's go!!"{w}
"Ooh~ I'm gonna lop off some heads~!"{w}
note: Maniron (ninja-style beheading joke, cf. slice_05 rows 329-330).

en: Leave
note: Menu choice (30 dupes).

en: You sent Electra's party packing.{w}
note: Narration after the battle (30 dupes); subject = player party.

en: "Ow ow ow...{w}You guys are amazing..."{w}
"Not bad at all.{w}Still, Electra,{w}your alchemy spells are as half-baked as ever."{w}
note: Added "Electra" as the addressee: Mig answers this at row 274 by reassuring Electra.

en: "I wanted a Bulafei~~!"{w}
note: NEW NAME: Bluffy = alchemy spell (SPELL.CSV row 64: hides one ally from enemy targeting). Maniron wanted Electra to cast it on them; Electra's reply (row 273) settles it.

en: "Th-then go hide yourself!"{w}

"It's okay, Electra!
Your alchemy spells will get better from here on!"{w}
"Th... thank you, Mig..."{w}
"It's all right,{w}there's no need to rush."{w}
"I'll be lendin' a hand too, I will!"{w}
"Everyone... thank you.{w}Okay, so that's how it is,{w}next time I'll be able to do a lot more!"{w}{p}"See you!"{w}
Electra and the others went on their way.{w}
note: Narration (30 dupes).
Menu choice (silent option).

en: Talk to them
note: Menu choice (24 dupes).

en: "Look, alchemy spells and Rangers go well together.{w}But if your success rate's low, it's pointless."{w}
note: NEW TERM: kariudo (class) -> "Hunter"; check against the class list once UI is translated (an earlier English Elminage release may have used "Ranger").

en: "I know that already!{w}That's why I'm studying like this, okay!?"{w}
"Don't be so hard on the Miss!{w}I'll be pitchin' in too, I will!"{w}
"Maniron's gonna try hard too~!"{w}
note: Maniron refers to self by name in the source.

en: "That's right, Electra!{w}You can't go through life bending your convictions!{w}You can still do it! Hang in there!"{w}
note: Editorial: stiff phrasing; spoken form, matches Mig's 'bending your convictions' in row 335.

en: "You're right... I'll try a little harder!"{w}
"There's no need to hurry, just go at your own pace...{w}
note: Unclosed quote as in source; row 289 re-shows it.

en:
{0E}"There's no need to hurry, just go at your own pace...{0F}
Oh?"{w}
note: Korbitz notices the player party.

en: "Oh, it's you guys! What a coincidence!{w}
note: Unclosed quote as in source; row 291 re-shows it.

en:
{0E}"Oh, it's you guys! What a coincidence!{0F}
How's it going? Things are going great for us!"{w}
"Come to think of it, you got the better of us last time.{w}It won't go that way this time, got it?"{w}
"Yamuru, you're more hot-blooded than you look.{w}Didn't you have a rule about never doing anything that doesn't pay?"{w}
"There's something I want to check..."{w}
"I'll be showin' what I'm made of too!"{w}
"Chop-chop, off with their heads~~~!"{w}
"Hm? Fine by me, but...?{w}
note: Unclosed quote as in source; row 298 re-shows it (source drops the "?" there, mirrored).

en:
{0E}"Hm? Fine by me, but...{0F}
Okay, everyone, let's go!"{w}
"...Just as I thought."{w}
note: What Yamuru wanted to check (row 294) is never stated here; left vague.

en: "What's wrong?"{w}
"No, it's nothing.{w}
note: Unclosed quote as in source; row 302 re-shows it.

en:
{0E}"No, it's nothing.{0F}
You lot look like a pretty good party."{w}

"Well, it's parties like ours, with a unicorn,
that are the rare ones, y'know."{w}
note: Maniron cuts in on Yamuru's praise of the player party: having a unicorn makes their own party the special one.

en: "Having me around is proof of Innocence, after all!"{w}
note: "Innocent" capitalised to keep the link with the Innocent series / never-changed-class idea (pilot row 33; Mig taunts Yamuru as a class-changer in slice_05 row 343). Whose innocence is left open, as in the source.

en: "Yeah, yeah, you're absolutely right."{w}
"Miss! It's about time we..."{w}
"You're right.{w}
note: Unclosed quote as in source; row 308 re-shows it.

en:
{0E}"You're right.{0F}
We won't lose next time, you hear? See you!"{w}

note: Menu choice.

en: "But I really do need to study...{w}Even you can read and write, right, Yamuru?"{w}

"That's a harsh way to put it.
What good is a bounty hunter who can't read a wanted poster?"{w}

"I can't read, but
it's never been a problem, y'know?"{w}
"I'll teach you, then.{w}Perhaps we'll hold a little study session one of these days, hm?"{w}
"I hate studyyying..."{w}
"But what about textbooks... and the money for them?"{w}
"Oh, we'll manage somehow."{w}
"Electra, Electra, look!"{w}
"Oh! You again, in a place like this!"{w}
"We must share quite the bond of fate, eh?"{w}

"We've been getting stronger too, you know,
so we won't lose this time!"{w}
"All right then,{w}let's go, everyone!"{w}
note: Editorial: spelling 'All right' as in rows 93/266.

en: "Mighty impressive, as always!"{w}
note: Post-battle line (player won); [JP] read as praise of the player party. Works in all 6 dupes.

en:
"Oh, that reminds me.
Do you guys know anything about the Moonlight Spirit?"{w}
note: New term [JP] = "Moonlight Spirit"; [JP] (row 324) = "Sun Spirit". Both recur often (ITEM_TEXT pairs them as paired spirit motifs); propose for glossary.

en: "You really do march to your own beat.{w}The Moonlight Spirit? Don't you mean the Sun Spirit?"{w}
"Nope, the Moonlight Spirit.{w}I've been kinda sorta looking for it.{w}And since I can't find it, it bugs me even more~"{w}
"One way or another, you guys sure know a lot...{w}I really do need to study.{w}
note: [JP] kept as "you guys": could be aimed at Maniron/Yamuru (who just talked spirits) or the player party; English keeps both readings.
{0E}..{0F} re-displays row 326 (same English, {w} -> \n as in source), then continues.

en: "Then just change classes."{w}
"Ninja! Ninja's the way to go!{w}YAMURU IS DECAPITATED!{w}
note: Hiragana [JP] mimics the Wizardry battle message; rendered as caps system message "YAMURU IS DECAPITATED!".
[JP] = Buddhist altar bell rung for the dead (comic "he's dead"); rendered "*ding* R.I.P.!" to carry the meaning.

en: "Why's it gotta be me!?"{w}

"Oh, pipe down.{w}We don't neeeed a thief who can't
even disarm traps!"{w}
note: Aimed at Yamuru (reply to "Why me?"); pilot row 362 confirms Yamuru has thief skills.
Wizardry reference: [JP] (party teleported into rock). Rendered as a centered system message "*INSIDE THE STONE*"; leading spaces kept for centering, can be dropped if the wrapper mishandles them.

en: "W-wait a sec..."{w}
"That's right! Electra, don't give up!{w}You're gonna make loads of money as an alchemist, right?{w}Don't go bending your convictions!"{w}
"Look.{w}Electra, you need to knock it off too.{w}If you keep wavering any longer, I'm out."{w}
"Hold... on, Yamuru...{w}Where's this coming from all of a sudden...?"{w}
"Someone who's half-hearted drags everyone else down too."{w}
"Aw, don't go sayin' that, chief!{w}I'll just dig in all the harder to make up for it!"{w}
note: [JP] (Mokero addressing Yamuru) -> "chief" to avoid a gendered "bro"; glossary gender for Yamuru is unknown.

en:
"That's right!
Electra's working really hard, you know!"{w}
note: Avoided "her" (Electra gender unknown in glossary).

en:
"You'd better think a little harder{w}about what you're actually
saying."{w}
"Says the one who's already changed classes!"{w}
note: "the one" instead of "the guy" (gender unknown).

en: "...I'll stick with you a little longer, at least.{w}Studying's something you can start bit by bit, too.{w}Now give me an answer."{w}
note: Order kept: stick around / studying can start bit by bit / give an answer.

en:
"......Yeah... You're right...
I'll try a little harder...{w}...Is that okay?"{w}
"...Fine.{w}Anyway, we're moving on.{w}Hanging around here forever won't get us anywhere."{w}
"Right!{w}Well then, you guys take care too, okay?"{w}
"Dvel Soft Steel and Frozen Elven Iron..."
note: data row (overheard line before the Talk/Leave choice). 42 chars; source slot is 40 bytes but text is relocated. New item names: [JP] "Dvel Mild Steel", [JP] "Frozen Elven Iron" (no ITEM.json English yet).

en: "Those two make an Angel's Window...{w}I know that one, since I've made it before.{w}
note: New item name: [JP] "Angel's Window" (RENKIN recipe: Dvel x Frozen Elven = Angel's Window, matches the line).

Kanji-reading joke adapted: Electra misreads [JP] (reads [JP] as "ao"). English: she mispronounces the coined item name "Mazurite" (new name for [JP], ma+azurite). Rows 351-361 depend on this name; if the item list picks another name, rework these rows.

en: "Miss, that'd be '-rite'..."{w}
note: [JP] -> "Miss" (Mokero's fixed address for Electra; it is the source word, not an inferred gender). Mokero corrects only the misread syllable, as in the source ([JP]).

en: "Huh? Oh, so it's pronounced 'Mazurite'!"{w}
"...Heyyy, some alchemist you are~~..."{w}
note: [JP] as a mocking address -> "some alchemist you are~~".

en: "B-but I know the real thing when I see it, and I can transmute it,{w}and I know what it's called and everything!{w}...Even if I didn't know how to read it."{w}
note: [JP] (what it is called) vs [JP] (how it is read) kept as "know what it's called" / "how to read it".

en: "It's that sort of carelessness, you see,{w}that leaves you red-faced in front of others like this...{w}Now, can you spell 'Mazurite'?"{w}
"Um... 'Mazuright'..."{w}
note: Wrong-kanji homophone [JP] -> misspelling "Mazuright" (looks similar, sounds the same), so row 361 still works.

en: "Ooh, that's our Miss! Beautifully done!"{w}
"...Isn't that kinda wrong-ish?"{w}
"'Mazurite'... Like this."{w}
"It looks close and it sounds the same, so who cares!"{w}
"Now, now, take your time learning it.{w}I'd call that... sixty out of a hundred, shall we say."{w}
note: [JP] -> "sixty out of a hundred".

en:
"Way to go, Electra!
That's a better score than last time!"{w}

"I guess so.........{w}Hmm, with this stuff, I guess the only way
is to write it out a lot until it sticks..."{w}
"...Electra?"{w}

"Ahahahaha!
Mig, Electra thinks you're a pest!"{w}

"Huh!? That's not true, Mig!
Thank you, okay?"{w}
"...Am I getting in your way, Electra?"{w}
"You're overthinking it. It's fine!{w}

{0E}"You're overthinking it. It's fine!{0F}
Oh, it is you guys.{w}Sorry I'm always so slow to notice!"{w}
note: {0E}..{0F} re-displays row 369.

en: "Maybe they're all ninjas?{w}
note: Third person ("they") for the player party, matching Mokero's reply in row 373; source [JP] is ambiguous between talking to or about them.

en:
{0E}"Maybe they're all ninjas?{0F}
Chop! Off with their heads!"{w}
note: {0E}..{0F} re-displays row 371. [JP] -> "Chop! Off with their heads!"

en:
"Nah, nah, maybe{w}every last one of 'em's a thief,
same as me, eh?"{w}
"Okay, okay, that's enough!{w}Now then, let's put all that studying to the test!{w}...Mig?"{w}

"No, it's nothing, Electra!
Let's show them what we can do!"{w}
"Yeah, let's!"{w}
"...Heeeads!!"{w}
note: [JP] -> Maniron craving heads.

en: "...Electra, am I really not getting in your way?"{w}
"Seriously, what's wrong?{w}Of course you're not."{w}
"But we couldn't win this time either...{w}Electra, could it be you actually want to change classes?{w}Because if you do, I..."{w}
note: Accuracy: 'moshikashite ... n ja nai no' is a tentative guess ('could it be'); 'don't you really want' read as a challenge/negation.

en: "Took you long enough to figure it out."{w}
"Yamuru!{w}

note: {0E}..{0F} re-displays row 382.

en: "Really? Are you really sure?"{w}

"Really.
The more I learn, the more I can do,{w}and I keep wondering what I'll be able to do next..."{w}{p}"Lately studying's been so much fun I can hardly stand it.{w}Maybe I should've started sooner?"{w}{p}"So you keep cheering me on, just like that,{w}so I don't run away from it.{w}That way I can try all the harder. ...Is that okay?"{w}
note: [JP] = Mig (reply to Mig's worry); kept as "you", the scene settles it.

en:
"...Yeah! If you're asking, Electra,
I'll cheer you on forever and ever!{w}Go for it, Electra! I'll always be with you!!"{w}
"Ugh, now the noisy one's back to normal..."{w}

"Hey, you! I'll chop your head off!
Read the room!"{w}
note: [JP] (rough "you") -> "Hey, you!"; threat kept at full strength.

en: "Reckon that's a happy endin' all round, eh?"{w}
"So it would seem."{w}

"All right, you guys!
It won't go the same way next time, okay?{w}Well then, take care!"{w}
note: Editorial: spelling 'All right' as in rows 93/266.

en: "Oh?"
"How are you guys doing?{w}We're doing great over here.{w}I've learned a whole lot more letters, too!"{w}
"Half-baked or not,{w}once you start something, you see it through till it's settled.{w}Otherwise nothing good ever comes of it..."{w}
"...Sounds like someone's speakin' from experience!"{w}
note: Refers to Yamuru without naming; "someone's" avoids a pronoun (gender unknown).

en:
"Words only ever come from what
a body has lived through, after all..."{w}
note: Korbitz, old-man register: "a body" = a person.

en:
"That's what they call
a contrary sort, right...?"{w}
note: Editorial: 'crank' (eccentric/grouch) did not match hinekure-mono (twisted/contrary person) (accuracy item 3); 'contrary sort' keeps Yamuru's 'I am not!' reply working.

en: "I am not!"{w}
note: [JP] answers the "crank" jab (and the experience jab before it) -> "I am not!".

en:
"Go, Electra!
I'll always be cheering for you!"{w}
